sources.title: Azerbaijan MFA: ordinary passport of the Republic of Azerbaijan
sources.publisher: Embassy of the Republic of Azerbaijan in Moldova, Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: A current Azerbaijani MFA consular page expressly describes the ordinary passport, its citizen eligibility, issuance authority and use for travel abroad.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The ordinary passport of the Republic of Azerbaijan is issued ... to citizens ... residing abroad by the diplomatic mission or consulate.

sources.title: ASAN: issuance and replacement of national passports
sources.publisher: State Agency for Public Service and Social Innovations under the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan
sources.officialityEvidence: ASAN's current official citizen service identifies the national passport as a regular passport and describes its issuance to Azerbaijani citizens for travel abroad.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A regular passport is issued ... for persons over 18 years of age for a ten-year period.

sources.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina FIPA: visa information for visitors
sources.publisher: Foreign Investment Promotion Agency of Bosnia and Herzegovina
sources.officialityEvidence: The current visitor guidance is published by a state institution on the Council of Ministers' gov.ba domain and lists Azerbaijan in its ordinary-passport visa-free agreement section.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Holders of valid ordinary passports ... do not require a visa ... 2. Azerbaijan.

sources.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina Service for Foreigners' Affairs: stay of aliens
sources.publisher: Service for Foreigners' Affairs of Bosnia and Herzegovina
sources.officialityEvidence: The competent Service's current guidance states that the Decision on Visas controls the visa-free list and the statutory limit for visa-free stays.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa-free aliens may enter and stay up to 90 days over a six-month period.

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service: 2026 Tourism (F5A) visa service level
sources.officialityEvidence: Nigeria Immigration Service's April 2026 service-level document makes F5A tourism electronically issuable to eligible countries and its Appendix I assigns Azerbaijan payable single-entry fees, distinguishing it from the waiver cohort.
sources.supportingExcerpt: F5A Eligibility: Citizens of all countries ... Receive Visa certificate via email. Azerbaijan $78 $78 $78 $78.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea Government: online visa is operational
sources.publisher: Government of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea Information and Press Office
sources.officialityEvidence: The institutional Government page identifies equatorialguinea-evisa.com as the operational visa site and says interested visitors can obtain a visa online without attending in person.
sources.supportingExcerpt: todos los interesados en viajar al país podrán conseguir su visado sin tener que desplazarse físicamente.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: live eligibility, regular-passport and delivery translation asset
sources.officialityEvidence: The Government-authenticated exact domain's live English translation asset says all nationalities can apply, limits the process to a regular passport, and sends eVisas by email with PDF download.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Nationalities can apply for an E- Visa ... All E-Visa are sent by email.

policies.title: Azerbaijani ordinary passports: Bosnia and Herzegovina short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Current Bosnia and Herzegovina government guidance lists Azerbaijan's valid ordinary passports in the visa-free agreement section and states the general visa-free stay limit.
conditions: Use the ordinary Azerbaijani passport issued to a citizen for travel abroad. Current BiH government guidance names Azerbaijan in its valid-ordinary-passport visa-free agreement list.
The general visa-free stay is up to 90 days in a six-month period. This does not transfer service, diplomatic, return, identity-document, employment, residence, carrier or final-admission treatment.

policies.title: Azerbaijani ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism service routes eligible Azerbaijan-passport applicants through electronic issuance and lists Azerbaijan's payable single-entry fee.
conditions: Use the ordinary Azerbaijani passport issued to a citizen for travel abroad. F5A is tourism only, single entry and up to 30 days.
Apply online, upload documents and pay. The emailed certificate is electronic issuance before travel, not online preapproval followed by border issuance.

Although F5A excepts ECOWAS States and countries with visa-waiver agreements, Appendix I expressly assigns Azerbaijan a payable $78 single-entry fee, establishing that this ordinary-passport route is not waived.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service eVisa portal
steps: Apply online with the Azerbaijani ordinary passport and stated tourism documents.
Pay the applicable fee and obtain the visa certificate by email before departure.
Present the issued record for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: Azerbaijani ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's Government-authenticated live eVisa service accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the eVisa by email/PDF.
conditions: Use the ordinary Azerbaijani passport used for travel; the live asset excludes non-regular travel documents.
Register, upload visitor documents, pay online and obtain the eVisa by email/PDF before travel. This is electronic issuance, not a visa on arrival.
Purpose, passport validity, health, entry-point, carrier and final-admission requirements remain separate.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea official eVisa service
steps: Register using the Azerbaijani ordinary passport for travel.
Pay and receive the issued eVisa by email/PDF before travel.
Carry the issued record for final immigration processing.
